p: soul may bless thee before I: The carnal affection he had for his son made him forget what God spoke to his wife. Ge 25:23.
Go now to the flock: This trickery is worthy of blame because she should have waited for God to perform his promise.
Upon me be thy curse: The assurance of God's decree made her bold.
I am Esau thy firstborn: Although Jacob was assured of this blessing by faith: yet he did evil to seek it by lies, even more because he abuses God's name through it.
voice is Jacob's voice: This declares that he suspected something, yet God would not have his decree altered.
trembled very exceedingly: In perceiving his error, by appointing his heir against God's sentence pronounced before.
Jacob: In Ge 25:26 he was so called because he held his brother by the heel, as though he would overthrow him: and therefore he is here called an overthrower, or deceiver.
For Isaac did this as he was the minister and prophet of God.
by thy sword shalt thou live: Because your enemies will be all around you.
serve thy brother: Which was fulfilled in his posterity the Idumeans: who were tributaries for a time to Israel, and later came to freedom.
then will I slay my brother: Hypocrites only abstain from doing evil for fear of men.
as touching thee: He hopes to recover his birthright by killing you.
deprived also of you both in: For the wicked son will kill the godly: and the plague of God will later come on the wicked son.
daughters of Heth: Who were Esau's wives.
what good shall my life do: By this she persuaded Isaac to agree to Jacob's leaving.
